children: South Korea's finance minister said on Wednesday authorities were closely monitoring bond markets and would take market stabilising measures if bond yields rise excessively.
The measures could include conducting treasury bond repurchases or utilising excess tax revenue to reduce bond issuance, Minister Lee Hyoung-il said at a meeting with other economic policymakers.
